preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the binary tree must be between 1 and 10,000.
The data of each node in the binary tree must be between 1 and 10,000.
The target value must be between 1 and 10,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the value of the mirror node of the target node.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if mirror_value is None else True
postconditions.description: If the mirror node does not exist, the output must be -1.
